title: TypeScript 7 CI causal graph
description: Deterministic map from CI checks to root causes, consequences, and first fixes.

roots.label: Dependency graph is not reproducible
roots.childExplanation: The instruction book and the Lego pieces do not match.

roots.label: The compared compilers are not the intended compilers
roots.childExplanation: Two runners may be wearing the wrong name tags, so we could time the same runner twice.

roots.label: Install and QA lifecycle contracts disagree
roots.childExplanation: The toy only works when the big repair toolbox is present.

roots.label: The evidence run did not produce trustworthy results
roots.childExplanation: The race happened, but the scoreboard is missing or shows different finishes.

roots.label: The result is not tied to one immutable source
roots.childExplanation: We know a score, but we forgot which race and which day it came from.

consequences.label: Another runner may get a different dependency graph and a different result
Performance and compatibility conclusions may compare the wrong executables
Production-only installation can fail before the package is usable
A release decision can be made from incomplete or incorrect evidence
Readers cannot prove which revision, workflow, and artifact support the claim

fixes.label: Restore package-lock.json and npm ci before investigating benchmark behavior
Repair compiler shims and verify tsc and tsc6 versions before measurement
Allow omit-dev installation while keeping explicit QA verification fail-closed
Repair the failed QA or output-parity stage and regenerate artifacts
Link immutable commits, workflow runs, artifacts, and synchronized findings

signals.label: Locked dependency installation
signals.childSymptom: The box contains different pieces than the instructions expect.

signals.label: Stable QA compiler selection
signals.childSymptom: We cannot prove which runner is TypeScript 6 and which is TypeScript 7.

signals.label: Checker-scaling compiler selection
signals.childSymptom: The checker race may use the wrong runners.

signals.label: Production-only installation
signals.childSymptom: The toy cannot be taken out of the box without the repair toolbox.

signals.label: QA verification fails closed without the toolchain
signals.childSymptom: The safety lock says everything is fine even when the measuring tools are missing.

signals.label: Stable compatibility and benchmark QA
signals.childSymptom: The race or its checks did not finish correctly.

signals.label: Checker-scaling benchmark
signals.childSymptom: The checker race did not finish or did not produce a trustworthy scoreboard.

signals.label: Normalized output parity
signals.childSymptom: The two builders produced different toys.

signals.label: Immutable evidence references
signals.childSymptom: The score points to a page that can change later.

signals.label: Findings and publication status synchronization
signals.childSymptom: Two notebooks tell different stories about the same race.

signals.label: Checker-scaling workflow attribution
signals.childSymptom: The score is attached to the wrong race.
